hypothesis: With identical five-block ActionDiT weights, data, seeds and optimization, block-aligned H3 K/V from layers 9/19/29/39/49 will learn more target-aligned visual conditioning than repeating layer49 into every block, without worsening action range or gripper control.
single_variable: carrier_source_mode: Candidate D uses aligned_5layer; Candidate D0 repeats an independent clone of layer49 K/V into all five otherwise identical action blocks.
parent_baseline: Candidate D0 repeat_layer49 trained concurrently from the same initialization and evaluated on the same v4 balanced-80 IDs at s10/s50/s250/s500/s963.

architecture.field: D versus D0 trainable graph and initialization
architecture.paper: supplementary motivation for per-block video K/V
architecture.upstream_code: five DreamWAM action blocks consume per-block video K/V
architecture.local: same state_dict keys, tensor values and parameter count; only carrier_source_mode differs
architecture.rationale: D0 is a local controlled parent, not an official DreamWAM configuration.

data.field: v4 episode-disjoint training and validation data
data.paper: not used as the local LIBERO data contract
data.upstream_code: not used as the local LIBERO data contract
data.local: both arms use the same 7,710 train windows, cumulative disjoint stage slices and the same v4 balanced-80 IDs
data.rationale: Data order, global batch and consumed sample IDs are matched between D and D0.

action.local: 7D horizon32, StarWAM minmax clip5, gripper last dimension
action.rationale: The carrier mode does not change the action contract.

objective.local: identical continuous-FP32 shift5 flow loss, text, proprio and action noise; only H3 K/V source mapping differs
objective.rationale: No auxiliary loss or parameter group is added to either arm.

optimization.paper: not used for the local budget
optimization.upstream_code: not used for the local budget
optimization.local: 8 GPUs per arm, global batch8, AdamW, warmup1000, checkpoints s10/s50/s250/s500/s963, 7,704 unique samples per arm
optimization.rationale: The two arms use identical stage slices, topology, seeds and optimizer schedule.

evaluation.local: same 80 IDs, noise, seed42, batch1, shift5, ten-step Euler, language replacement and source-sample visual shuffle
evaluation.rationale: D and D0 are strictly paired to each other on v4; neither is strictly paired to the older R1/G v8 reports.

evidence: Official DreamWAM HEAD 6e989facc0c452fd3488d75f60bc36411005558c and local commit e85c10c.
D/D0 state_dict and initialization identity tests pass.
8,560/8,560 cache audit; 7,710 train windows; 170 validation episodes; episode overlap 0.
Same shifted-flow implementation and deterministic rank-distinct seeds.
Same 8-rank topology and cumulative disjoint sample-slice gate.
Candidate D five-block/proprio gradients finite and non-zero; D0 uses the same trainable graph.
Target evidence for D0 and the paired 8-rank run.
Candidate D schema-v2 fresh restore max_abs=0; D0 uses identical persistence code and will be independently checked at s10.
D0 is code-complete but has no trained checkpoint yet; this paired canary creates it.
Not released until paired offline action/range/gripper/conditioning gates pass.

decision.rationale: The bounded paired run is needed to create the direct parent and a one-epoch learning curve; it cannot by itself support a closed-loop or cross-v8 effectiveness claim.
decision.launch_command: torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=8 scripts/h3wam/train_h3_int8_dreamwam_kv_carrier.py MANIFEST --source-manifest SOURCE --cache-root CACHE --kv-subdir h3_int8_dreamwam_kv_5x32_canary_v1 --enable-dreamwam-kv-carrier --verify-h3-checkpoint-sha256 --steps 10 --limit 80 --save-checkpoint CHECKPOINT_S10 --output REPORT_S10; add --enable-d0-repeat-layer49 only for the D0 arm

paired_gate.progress_condition: At the same checkpoint, D must improve at least one of physical MSE/ADE or gripper macro-F1 relative to D0 without worsening the other key action and range metrics; visual/language response must remain finite and non-collapsed.
stop_conditions: sample overlap or duplicate consumed ID
persistent action-range explosion relative to D0
paired_gate.claim_boundary: This experiment can attribute aligned multi-layer K/V benefit versus repeat-layer49 on v4 only. It cannot establish superiority to R1/G v8 or LIBERO closed-loop success.
